title: [Pre Order] Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 256GB $0 Upfront with 36-Month $79/Month Optus Plan (In-Store Only) @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra 256GB $0 Upfront with 36-Month $79/Month Optus Plan (In-Store Only) @ Harvey Norman

[qtvinsta] The promo in that link is $0 upfront for those devices on those corresponding Optus plans
[sct911] Opened link and can see $300 pre order voucher on page , will that apply to outright only or plan as well ?
[jimojr] This is the best Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra deal so far. I ordered one for $1,757 from the Samsung Education Store, including the case and screen protectors. Unfortunately, the payment wouldn't go through with either NAB Goodies or CBA Yello, so I missed out on the extra 5% first purchase discount.
[Sanji666] I bought Ultra as well, with a case and screen protector. But I paid $1979 in total, did I miss some vounchers?
[Masticccc] Unless you buying the 512gb version then yes. 256gb version with all the code (150$ UNFOLD, 250$ FF8S, 90$ eVoucher, 50$ student voucher, 5% first purchase) should bring you down to 1600~ish mark
[wishbest] Any idea what the minimum cost for this would be?
[Zeee] Can u please explain the hack. Never got plans in my life
[Karforoffer] You take the phone on plan. Pay 79/m for 4 months (120 days) and then cancel the plan with minimum payment of 1264. In total you'd pay ~1580 for a phone that's roughly 2400 in full price.
[Zeee] @Karforoffer: Thats cool. R we talking about fold ultra 8 512gb?
[swashed] I got the s26u deal. You just go into the store, sign up for the plan, pay the first 3 payments of the plan as the bills come in, and on the 120th day exactly, you cancel the plan, you'll be able to see in your optus app's contract details that the remaining balance has reduced. If you wait until the next day you will be charged 1 extra month ($79 in this instance) as optus doesn't charge pro rata for the 5th month. That is my understanding of it anyway.
[jimojr] @swashed:
If you wait until the next day you will be charged 1 extra month ($79 in this instance) as optus doesn't charge pro rata for the 5th month. That is my understanding of it anyway.
That's not quite right. I've signed up twice already.
Optus sets your billing date (mine was the 2nd of each month). For example, if you sign up today, your first bill will cover the remaining days of this month plus the next full month (around 8 + 30 days).
About four months after you sign up, the Outstanding charges will disappear in the Optus app. At that point, you can cancel or port out your number and only pay the Early Termination Fee.
[BlackorRed] what are the advantages of this $79 vs $69 plan deal? which cancellation payout is cheaper? I'm looking for 512gb version so paying extra $300 on top price difference
[jimojr] The $69 plan is for the Galaxy Z Fold8. If you cancel after about four months, you'll pay the $1,104 ETF plus around four months of plan fees ($69 × 4).
[cornflakes] The terms and conditions don't list shit.
So from above comments, there seems to be a 4 month minimum period on the Optus plan before you can cancel and pay the remaining cost for the device? Whatever that amount is?
$300 gift card is only for outright purchase? Not if purchased on the Optus plan?
I can't find any details about this on the HN link to confirm.
